# Vendored parser dependencies

These source snapshots make Docker builds reproducible when GitHub DNS is unavailable. They are unmodified pinned upstream revisions already declared in `pyproject.toml`:

- `yamaps_parser`: `5669da6d796f4546c5fb8c4725f8965a4c54c763`
- `parser-2gis-new`: `a773258a12d70f6523beaba8d7d63f2dfccecfdb`

Upstream licensing and notices are retained in each directory and in the project notices.
